question: To multiply, the rhabdoviruses enter the host cell by:

options.opc: Depopolimerization of the virion as a consequence of the interaction with the cellular receptor.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Endocytosis -> viral entry into the host cell -> 80% CHAIN: Depopolimerization of the virion as a consequence of the interaction with the cellular receptor -> facilitation of viral entry -> 70% CHAIN: Direct translocation -> rapid entry of the virus into the host cell -> 80%
analysis: Rhabdoviruses enter the host cell through endocytosis, a process where the virus is engulfed by the host cell membrane and taken into the cell.
